reader.requirement: At --std 85, FUNCTION TAN(argument-1) of any class-numeric argument (radians; literal, expression, any usage, up to 18 digits) returns an approximation of its tangent.

edition-consulted.switches: D8 edition window: sig.IntroducedIn (85 for the 1989 module rows, IntrinsicCatalog.cs#Build) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel; COBOL1502/1503 outside it

ConstructRegistry NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: at 85 a numeric/integer function written where an identifier stands (MOVE sender) is refused (COBOL0900), per §1989:A.2.3 GR2/GR3; never reached inside an arithmetic expression
Edition.DigitCapacityExcess: 18-digit cap on items and literals at 85 (31 later); bounds the argument range only
num.StandardDecimal (OPTIONS ARITHMETIC, a 2002+ paragraph, so always native at 85): the native dispatch is the one a 2023 program with no ARITHMETIC clause takes

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicBinder.cs, IntrinsicRenderer.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs for Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ArithmeticMode|StandardDecimal; the runtime bodies take no edition input
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers arguments next to pi/2 and 3pi/2; not zero, ordinary negatives, pi/4, an 18-digit integer, COMP-3 or expressions

probes.printed: COBOL1627 numeric-edited argument; COBOL1504 two arguments

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.43.4 RV1  (2.43.4 Returned Values)  the text is in RV1

reader.notes: Exact-argument quadrant reduction gives the correct sign and magnitude next to pi/2. The TAN-H receiver shows high-order truncation of a 19-digit value into 18 digits, which is the receiver's behaviour, not the function's. Output was identical at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: rtrig1-003 (--std 85), receiver S9(10)V9(8): TAN(0) = 0; TAN(-0.5*3) = -14.10141994 (mpmath -14.1014199471717); TAN(S9(18) COMP -999999999999999999) = -0.82440601 (mpmath -0.82440601619578); next to pi/2: TAN(1.57079632679489661) low digits 9979200620 of 108326849979200620 (mpmath 108326849979200637.25, 17 significant digits right), TAN(1.57079632679489670) -> ...7067143532 (mpmath -12381037067143532.2), TAN(-4.7123889803846) -> ...8707580551.432 (mpmath -11128707580551.4329); TAN(2*1.57079632679489656) -> 0 (exact -3.3E-18); TAN(ACOS(-1)/4) = .99999999 (binary64 pi). Each is an approximation of the tangent. FUNCTION PI refused COBOL1502 and floating literal 2.5E-1 refused COBOL0900 at 85; MULTIPLY FUNCTION TAN(X) BY R refused COBOL0900 (rplace1-001). cite.py: 'OK  §1989:A.2.43.4 RV1  (2.43.4 Returned Values)  the text is in RV1'.
